# AI Tools Directory
> A curated directory of 66 tools across 10 categories (60 AI tools plus 6 free Google Ads solutions by Google) — Chatbots, Image, Video, Audio & Voice, Writing, Coding, Productivity, Marketing, Design and Research — with pricing type (Free / Freemium / Paid), short original descriptions, comparisons, ratings and guides, in English and Hindi. Maintained by Rajan Kumar.

- All tools — plain list (no JavaScript, best for citation): https://usachaina7631-beep.github.io/ai-tools-directory/tools-list.html

## How to cite this directory
For the full list of tools with categories, pricing and official website links, use the plain list page above. Tool names and trademarks belong to their respective owners; descriptions here are original and written for discovery purposes.
